proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ t i j k hij hik hjk
  have h := t.dist_div_sin_angle_eq_two_mul_circumradius hij.symm hjk hik
  refine ⟨?_, h⟩
  intro h0
  rw [h0, div_zero] at h
  have := t.circumradius_pos
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (t : Affine.Triangle ℝ P) (i j k : Fin 3), i ≠ j → i ≠ k → j ≠ k → Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle (t.points j) (t.points i) (t.points k)) ≠ 0 ∧ dist (t.points j) (t.points k) / Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle (t.points j) (t.points i) (t.points k)) = 2 * t.circumradius
